field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable or disable this alert rule. Disabled rules are not evaluated during polling.

field.label: Event Type
field.help:
Select the condition that triggers this alert. Available event types:

Switch Offline — triggers when a previously online switch stops responding. Threshold is ignored.
Switch New — triggers when a new switch is discovered via LLDP or SNMP within the last polling interval. Threshold is ignored.
Port Down — triggers when a port is administratively up but operationally down (link failure). Threshold is ignored.
Port Errors — triggers when the combined input and output error count on a port exceeds the configured threshold.

All alerts are emitted to syslog (LOCAL0 facility) and logged in the Alert Log below.

field.label: Threshold
field.help: Numeric threshold value. Only used by the Port Errors event type — an alert fires when (input errors + output errors) on any port exceeds this value. Ignored for all other event types.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional note to identify this rule (e.g. "Alert on core switch failure"). Shown in the rules list for reference.
